title: Favorite drummers: Cottrell and Piron's band
summary: He admired old man Cottrell with Piron's band as the king of drummers, and Paul Barbarin.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Can you tell us who your favorite drummers are, or were in the old days? Did you get, I guess you were busy most of the time and didn't get to hear many of the other bands. Which ones did you like when you heard them?
I used to like old man Contra. The best.
Where did you hear him, whose band was he with when you heard it?
He was with P. Rohn. P. Rohn. That's one of the best drumming head, you know, in fact, I mean, he's one of the best. And I see Paul Barbera, I mean, he was good at that time too.

Oh yeah, they was all Roy and Happy and all of them, they was all good drummers. But like I said, old man, he was the king of all of them, old man Contra, you see. Cause he know that music, I mean, understand what I mean, he teached all of them. I mean, he's one of the best, I mean.
